sentences.en: The teacher affirmed the decision of the student council.
sentences.zh: 老师肯定了学生会的决定。

sentences.en: Many scientists affirm that life on Earth didn't arise by chance.
sentences.zh: 许多科学家认为地球上的生命并非偶然产生。

sentences.en: Affirming the consequent is an example of a formal logical fallacy.
sentences.zh: 断言结果是一种形式逻辑谬误的例子。
